sun.invoke.empty

类 Empty

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.invoke.empty.Empty

  • public class Empty
extends Object
    An empty class in an empty package. Used as a proxy for unprivileged code, since making access checks against it will only succeed against public methods in public types.

    This class also stands (internally to sun.invoke) for the type of a value that cannot be produced, because the expression of this type always returns abnormally. (Cf. Nothing in the closures proposal.)

    作者:
    jrose
